decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ +0.7% and S&P 500 +0.3% — no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we hold rather than force a buy into open slots. Existing positions are left to run; stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle exits automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted modestly higher today without a clear catalyst, consistent with a quiet, low-conviction trading session. NASDAQ's +0.7% gain outpaced the S&P 500's +0.3%, suggesting mild outperformance in growth/tech names. No major headline-driven moves were evident in today's session.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚，未見明顯催化劑，反映市場處於觀望格局。納斯達克指數升0.7%，跑贏標普500指數的0.3%升幅，顯示增長股／科技股表現相對較佳。今個交易日未見有重大新聞驅動的波動。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears rather than being invested just to stay fully invested. Holding cash below a comfortable buy threshold during a neutral market, as we did today, preserves flexibility for a genuine risk-on setup later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指保留在場邊的現金，待出現真正好機會時才動用，而非為求「滿倉」而勉強買入。像今日在中性市況下，現金未達到理想買入門檻時選擇持有觀望，正是保留彈性、等待更佳risk-on訊號的做法。
